dct_description_sm: Will be submitted to Remote Sensing of the Environment.

This dataset comprises carefully selected data and source code that support the analyses discussed in the accompanying manuscript. It includes specific airborne long-wave infrared (LWIR) hyperspectral data cubes, along with the code utilized for atmospheric compensation (AAC), methane plume detection, and quantitative retrieval of methane. The primary goal of this dataset is to promote reproducibility and to assist further research in the field of airborne hyperspectral methane remote sensing.
dct_title_s: Retrieving methane emission rates from airborne LWIR hyperspectral imaging using a physics-based model
